title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Lifecycle: Activation, Lapse, Pause, Suspension and Closure
content:
A Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan moves through five states: pending activation, active, paused, suspended and closed.

## Activation and lapse

A plan activates when the employer's payroll file matches the worker's employee number under the program agreement. An enrollment lapses only once the tier's activation window in calendar days has passed since the enrollment date without a match. Calendar days are counted from the day after the enrolled date, so the lapse date is the enrolled date plus the window.

*Boundary (hypothetical, 30-day window, enrolled 11 January, no match):* 10 February is the lapse date and the enrollment lapses on it; on 9 February it has not lapsed.

## Pause and resumption

A plan is paused when the employer's file reports the worker on leave or terminated or the employer's program agreement is suspended, and resumes when the worker is reported employed under a live agreement; recoveries and write-offs continue while a plan is paused, but no transfer is booked.

## Suspension and reinstatement

The desk suspends an active plan when it suspects account takeover or destination fraud, and lifts the suspension once the worker passes identity verification again and confirms the destinations on file. The desk may reinstate only a plan whose status is suspended.

## Closure

Closing a plan is the worker's own decision: the desk registers a closure request and the worker confirms it. A worker-confirmed closure applies only to a plan whose status is active. The closure takes effect on the request date when the outstanding balance is zero, and otherwise on the date the balance first reaches zero through recovery, voluntary payment or write-off; a worker cannot close a plan to avoid a recovery already due. A plan paused for an employment end closes once its balance is recovered or written off. A closed plan is never reopened; the worker enrolls again under the enrollment rules.

| From | To | Moved by |
|---|---|---|
| pending activation | active | the employer payroll file matching the worker |
| pending activation | closed | the enrollment lapsing unmatched after the activation window |
| active | paused | the employer reporting leave or termination, or the program agreement suspended |
| paused | active | the worker reported employed under a live agreement |
| active | suspended | the desk, on suspected account takeover or destination fraud |
| suspended | active | the desk, after identity re-verification and destination confirmation |
| active | closed | a worker-confirmed closure once nothing is outstanding |
| paused | closed | an employment end, once the balance is recovered or written off |
